name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: Early-season snow in the US Rockies; no major cold wave
state: Winter storm warnings covered mountain areas of Colorado and Nevada on 1 Nov, with up to 18 inches of snow forecast in south-west Colorado by 2 Nov. The Met Office had no UK warnings in force on 1 Nov, and no major cold wave or deadly winter storm is affecting large populations.
for_you: No widespread cold-weather disruption. Travellers to US mountain areas should follow National Weather Service warnings.
rubric_hit: No top-tier cold warnings across a major populated region

sources.title: Country Herald — Southwest Colorado winter storm warning: up to 18 inches by Monday 2 Nov

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
